Association Sportive la Jeunesse d'Esch/Alzette, usually abbreviated to Jeunesse Esch, is a professional football club based in Esch-sur-Alzette, in south-western Luxembourg. The side play in the National Division, the top tier of Luxembourgish football, and have won the league title on 28 occasions between 1921 and 2010, the most of any team in Luxembourg.
